name: Spectral Guardian
description: A ghostly fighter with spears and swords, anchored by duty.

abilities.name: Ghost
abilities.description: The Guardian has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

abilities.name: Grave Blade
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+6 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.
